text:
emma: Quick async standup — onboarding + QC notes
- yesterday: finished smoke eval for tinyQ-2 onboard; found a hallucination cluster on instruction-following prompts, added ~200 curated examples to promptset-b to tighten responses. Ran small cleanups to prompt templating.
- blockers: intermittent kv-cache mismatch on long-context runs (seen at ctx >= 6k) — tokens shift ~0.2% causing eval flakiness. Need help from runtime team for a reproducible patch/trace. Also infra quota hit on staging when running full sweep.
- today: kick off 10k eval sweep (spanish + long-context), open PR for prompt normalization, will triage KV restore trace with @raj and @anika.

raj: Got it. I can look at the KV trace after standup. Quick ask — did you pin the quant seed in the eval run? that can hide/reveal the mismatch.

jordan: FYI monitoring flagged a spike that lines up with your smoke run: https://console.redwood/alerts/234 — looks like a small tail latency bump and a few token misalignments.

anika: I reproduced the mismatch locally with the canary image. Minimal repro command:
```
docker run --rm -e MODEL=tinyq-2 redwood/runtime:canary \
  ./run_eval --ctx 8192 --seed 42 --promptset promptset-b.json
```
Gives token offset on sample id 142 and 189.

liam: Pushed a small test into infra tests to try to catch KV restore flakiness on dedicated staging. Also added a temp config flag you can try: `--kv-restore-mode=relaxed` should avoid strict match while we debug.

emma: Thanks — opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/918 (prompt normalization + tests). Small diff snippet in the PR:
```diff
- format_prompt(user_input)
+ format_prompt(user_input, normalize_whitespace=True)
```
Please tag if you spot any risky behavior.

qa-bot: QC regression alert: rouge drop 0.8% on instruction-following eval (recent patch), flagged 12 examples for manual review.

raj: I'll do the KV trace shortly and review the PR after lunch. If I find kernel-level cause I'll sync with eng-runtime.

anika: I'm blocked on a staging token quota for the full 10k sweep — @liam can you bump the staging pool for a couple hours?

liam: Done — bumped pool and started a smoke job. If you still hit the quota ping me and I'll escalate.

emma: Great — will rerun the 10k with relaxed kv mode and report back here. Thanks all :thumbsup:
